ingredients.name: Hydrogen
ingredients.desc: The main fuel. Stars fuse it into helium.

ingredients.name: Helium
ingredients.desc: What hydrogen becomes. Old stars burn it next.

ingredients.name: Carbon
ingredients.desc: Made inside ageing stars. It's in you, too!

ingredients.name: Oxygen
ingredients.desc: Forged in stars and spread by dying ones.

ingredients.name: Iron
ingredients.desc: Hmm… stars really don't like this one.

browndwarf.name: Brown dwarf
browndwarf.joke: Too small to ignite. It's basically a very warm potato.

reddwarf.name: Red dwarf
reddwarf.joke: Small, cosy and slow-cooked. It'll simmer for TRILLIONS of years.

sunlike.name: Sun-like star
sunlike.joke: Golden brown, done to perfection. Chef's kiss!

whitestar.name: Hot white star
whitestar.joke: Extra crispy. Bright, but it won't last as long.

bluegiant.name: Blue giant
bluegiant.joke: WAY too much heat! Lives fast, ends with a BANG.

stages.reddwarf: Red dwarf: burns slowly for trillions of years
stages.slowfade: Slowly runs out of fuel… longer than the universe has existed so far
stages.whitedwarf: White dwarf: a hot, Earth-sized leftover core that cools forever
stages.sunlike: Main sequence: steady, slowly brightening, for about 10 billion years
stages.whitestar: Main sequence: hot and bright, for under a billion years
stages.bluegiant: Main sequence: blazing, for only a few million years
stages.redgiant: Red giant: the core runs low on hydrogen and the star swells hundreds of times wider
stages.nebula: Planetary nebula: outer layers drift away as a glowing shell
stages.supergiant: Supergiant: fuses heavier elements, all the way up to iron
stages.supernova: Supernova: the iron core collapses and the star explodes
stages.neutronstar: Neutron star: a city-sized ball, denser than anything on Earth
stages.blackhole: Black hole: gravity so strong that not even light escapes
stages.browndwarf: Never ignites. Not quite a star.

ironFizzle: FZZZT! Fusing iron takes energy instead of giving it out. That's why a big star's iron core collapses!

cinder.goal: The jump drive needs a steady, Sun-like star to lock onto.
cinder.success: Jump drive locked on! Next stop: Veil.

veil.goal: Tobo wants a calm, long-lasting star to recharge slowly.
veil.success: Slow and steady. Recharged. Hollow, here we come.

hollow.goal: Forge a star like the Orrin's, then watch its whole life.
hollow.success: Now we know what the Orrin saw coming.
